files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body: **WIP: development in progress, not ready to use**

lines: A tagged pre-release is a release of its own: make changelog writes its section and make tag asks for it. The App Store shows it with the stable 0.0.3.
The App Store shows no changelog on the page of 0.0.3-post.1.
For a version with a '-' it reads the Unreleased section, which holds 1 line in CHANGELOG.md. The section of 0.0.3-post.1 appears with the stable 0.0.3, below that release's own section.
